lessons.title: by lazy and Custom Delegates
lessons.content: `by lazy { }` defers expensive initialization until first access and caches the result - thread-safe by default (LazyThreadSafetyMode.SYNCHRONIZED). Beyond the built-ins (lazy, observable, vetoable), you can write your own delegate by implementing getValue/setValue operator functions - useful for cross-cutting concerns like logging every property access or backing a property with SharedPreferences transparently.

lessons.title: Delegating to Interfaces (Composition over Inheritance)
lessons.content: Kotlin's `by` keyword also works at the class level to delegate interface implementation to another object - this gives you composition without boilerplate forwarding methods. Real scenario: implementing a decorator pattern around a Repository, where you want to add caching behavior on top of an existing implementation without rewriting every method.
